basic.en: Good morning, is the tea ready?

acha.hi: Kal raat ki party kaisi thi?

acha.en: I went to the bank, the post office, everywhere.

acha.hi: Tere ghar ke paas naya mall khula hai.
acha.en: A new mall has opened near your house.

acha.en: My train is two hours late.

acha.hi: Station pe hi wait kar raha hoon.
acha.en: I'm waiting at the station itself.

acha.en: When do the kids' exams start?

acha.en: That's why the TV is off at home.

bahut.hi: Bhai, aaj toh kismat ne saath de diya.
bahut.en: Bro, luck was on my side today.

bahut.hi: Kya hua, lottery lag gayi kya?
bahut.en: What happened, did you win the lottery?

bahut.hi: Nahi yaar, last minute pe flight mil gayi.
bahut.en: No man, I got a flight at the last minute.

bahut.en: He gets upset over every little thing.

bahut.hi: Uske saath sambhal ke baat karni padti hai.
bahut.en: You have to talk to him carefully.

bahut.hi: Haan, ek galat shabd aur khel khatam.
bahut.en: Yes, one wrong word and it's game over.

bahut.en: I met my school friends after so many years.

bahut.hi: Purani yaadein taaza ho gayin.
bahut.en: Old memories came flooding back.

bahut.hi: Sab kitne badal gaye hain, yaar.
bahut.en: Everyone has changed so much, man.

bahut.en: Deciding to quit the job wasn't easy.

bahut.hi: Par dil ki suni, aur kood pada.
bahut.en: But I listened to my heart and jumped in.

bahut.hi: Himmat chahiye iske liye, salaam hai.
bahut.en: That takes guts, respect.

bahut.en: Housework never really ends.

bahut.en: Finish one thing and the next is waiting.

bahut.en: That's why even Sunday feels like Monday.

bahut.en: Why are you so quiet today?

bahut.en: Say it, you'll feel lighter.

bahut.en: I've bought my own car for the first time.

bahut.en: When are you treating us to sweets?

bahut.en: Let me pay the EMI first, then we'll see.

bahut.en: It turned out far harder than I'd thought.

bahut.hi: Par aakhir mein sab theek ho gaya na?
bahut.en: But in the end everything worked out, right?

bahut.hi: Haan, ant bhala toh sab bhala.
bahut.en: Yes, all's well that ends well.
